properties.name: Target Type
properties.description: Required exact target family: Server, UCS-X Chassis, or Domain. A Domain upgrade covers both Fabric Interconnects; individual FI selection is not supported.

properties.name: Device Organization
properties.description: Exact Cisco Intersight organization used by the atomic to resolve the firmware target.

properties.name: Target Name
properties.description: Exact organization-scoped server, UCS-X chassis, or Domain name. The atomic validates identity and cardinality.

properties.name: Firmware Version
properties.description: Exact Cisco Repository firmware catalog version. No production version is prepopulated.

properties.name: Server Upgrade Mode
properties.description: Server-only mode: Start Immediately or Mount Only. Keep Start Immediately for chassis and Domain targets.

properties.name: Skip Estimate Impact
properties.description: Server-only option passed to the atomic. Keep false for chassis and Domain targets.

properties.name: Excluded Components
properties.description: Optional JSON string array passed unchanged to the atomic. Supported values depend on whether the target is a server or UCS-X chassis; Domain requires an empty value.

properties.name: Excluded Component PIDs
properties.description: Optional server-only JSON object passed unchanged to the atomic. Chassis and Domain targets require an empty value.

properties.name: XFM Upgrade Option
properties.description: UCS-X chassis-only option: none, full-shutdown, or partial-shutdown. Keep none for server and Domain targets.

properties.name: Enable Fabric Evacuation
properties.description: Domain switch-upgrade option. Keep true for server and UCS-X chassis targets.

properties.name: Switch Wait Timeout Minutes
properties.description: Domain WaitTimeOut from -1 through 1000. Default 0 starts immediately; -1 requires manual acknowledgement.

properties.name: Enable PSU Upgrade
properties.description: Domain switch-upgrade option. Keep false for server and UCS-X chassis targets.

properties.name: Enable PDB FPGA Upgrade
properties.description: Domain switch-upgrade option. Keep false for server and UCS-X chassis targets.

properties.name: Skip Wait for I/O Connectivity
properties.description: Domain option mapped by the atomic to SkipWaitForIoPathConnectivity. Keep false for server and chassis targets.

properties.name: Wait for Completion
properties.description: When true, the atomic performs its bounded five-attempt observation. This wrapper treats a validated still-running upgrade as successful HTTP-style 202, not failure. If false, set Wait Timeout Seconds to 0.

properties.name: Wait Timeout Seconds
properties.description: Bounded observation window passed to the atomic. Use 1 through 600 when waiting; 300 is recommended. Set 0 only when Wait for Completion is false.

properties.name: Confirm Upgrade
properties.description: Required explicit authorization for the firmware mutation. The workflow exits before calling the atomic unless this is true.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style outcome. 200 means confirmed completion, 202 means the upgrade was accepted and remains in progress, and 4xx/5xx values indicate failure.

properties.name: Status Message
properties.description: Human-readable outcome distinguishing confirmed completion from accepted or still-running state.

properties.name: Error Message
properties.description: Actionable failure detail. Empty for confirmed completion and accepted or still-running success.

properties.name: Result
properties.description: Structured JSON preserving atomic target, image, created resource, tracked status, readiness caveats, and retry guidance, augmented with the requested organization, target name, and firmware version.

Starts a Cisco Repository firmware upgrade through the existing Cisco Intersight atomic for one server, one UCS-X chassis, or one Domain/FI pair. Select an Intersight target with the permissions required by the atomic. Confirm Upgrade is false by default. The atomic owns target, image, relationship, readiness, duplicate-upgrade, input, and API validation; this wrapper does not repeat those checks. By default it observes the accepted resource for 300 seconds. Confirmed completion returns 200. A validated accepted or still-running result returns successful 202 so the 30-minute workflow limit does not create a false failure. It never resubmits after an ambiguous result. Domain means both FI fabrics, not one FI. Cisco Repository is the only image source; UCS-X and Domain catalog mapping require live-tenant validation, and eCMC is intentionally unsupported by this wrapper.
Stops before the firmware atomic unless Confirm Upgrade is explicitly true.
Returns a safe validation failure without calling the mutation atomic.
Matches every run where Confirm Upgrade is not true.
Populates all four standard outputs before ending the unconfirmed path.

variables_to_update.variable_value_new: Set Confirm Upgrade to true only after reviewing the target, version, and target-specific options.

properties.description: Ends this terminal path after all four standard outputs are populated.
Calls the existing atomic once, then classifies its standard outputs without repeating atomic validation or resubmitting.
Invokes the existing atomic exactly once. The atomic performs all input, target, image, duplicate-upgrade, readiness, request, and bounded-poll validation.

Inspects the atomic activity result and all four standard outputs. It preserves the atomic Result fields, adds the requested identifiers, maps validated accepted or bounded still-running state to 202 success, keeps confirmed completion at 200, and propagates genuine failures.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

activitySucceeded = sys.argv[1] == "True"
atomicStatusCode = sys.argv[2].strip()
atomicStatusMessage = sys.argv[3].strip()
atomicErrorMessage = sys.argv[4].strip()
atomicResultRaw = sys.argv[5].strip()
firmwareVersion = sys.argv[6]
deviceOrganization = sys.argv[7]
requestedTargetName = sys.argv[8]

result = None
try:
    candidate = json.loads(atomicResultRaw) if atomicResultRaw else None
    if isinstance(candidate, dict):
        result = candidate
except Exception:
    result = None

outcome = "failure"
outputStatusCode = "502"
outputStatusMessage = "Firmware upgrade atomic failed or returned an unusable contract"
outputErrorMessage = "The firmware upgrade atomic did not complete with a usable set of standard outputs. Inspect the atomic execution before retrying; this wrapper never resubmits."

requestAccepted = isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("requestAccepted") is True
completed = isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("completed") is True
atomicState = str(result.get("status") or "") if isinstance(result, dict) else ""
identityReady = isinstance(result, dict) and all(isinstance(result.get(key), str) and bool(result.get(key)) for key in ("targetType", "targetMoid", "imageMoid", "createdMoid"))
if activitySucceeded and result is not None and requestAccepted and identityReady and completed and atomicState == "completed" and atomicStatusCode.startswith("2"):
    outcome = "completed"
    outputStatusCode = "200"
    outputStatusMessage = atomicStatusMessage or "Firmware upgrade completed"
    outputErrorMessage = ""
elif result is not None and requestAccepted and not completed and ((activitySucceeded and identityReady and atomicState == "accepted" and atomicStatusCode in ("200", "202")) or (atomicStatusCode == "504" and (atomicState == "in-progress" or result.get("timeout") is True))):
    outcome = "accepted"
    outputStatusCode = "202"
    outputStatusMessage = "Firmware upgrade was accepted; bounded observation ended before the next status check" if result.get("timeout") is True else ("Firmware upgrade started and remains in progress after the bounded observation window" if atomicState == "in-progress" else "Firmware upgrade resource accepted")
    outputErrorMessage = ""
elif result is not None:
    outcome = "failure"
    outputStatusCode = atomicStatusCode if re.fullmatch(r"[45][0-9][0-9]", atomicStatusCode) is not None else "502"
    outputStatusMessage = atomicStatusMessage or "Firmware upgrade atomic reported failure"
    outputErrorMessage = atomicErrorMessage or atomicStatusMessage or "The firmware upgrade atomic reported failure without an error message. Inspect its Result before retrying."

if isinstance(result, dict):
    result["deviceOrganization"] = deviceOrganization
    result["requestedTargetName"] = requestedTargetName
    result["requestedFirmwareVersion"] = firmwareVersion
    result["wrapperDisposition"] = outcome
    result["wrapperStatusCode"] = outputStatusCode
    result["atomicStatusCode"] = atomicStatusCode or None
    result["atomicActivitySucceeded"] = activitySucceeded
    result["atomicStatusMessage"] = atomicStatusMessage or None
    result["atomicErrorMessage"] = atomicErrorMessage or None
    result["resourceIdentifiersAvailable"] = identityReady
    if atomicErrorMessage:
        result["atomicWarning"] = atomicErrorMessage
    if outcome == "accepted" and not identityReady:
        result["retryRequiresInspection"] = True
    outputResultJson = json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":"))
else:
    outputResultJson = json.dumps({"status":"failed","requestAccepted":False,"atomicActivitySucceeded":activitySucceeded,"atomicStatusCode":atomicStatusCode or None,"atomicStatusMessage":atomicStatusMessage or None,"atomicErrorMessage":atomicErrorMessage or None,"deviceOrganization":deviceOrganization,"requestedTargetName":requestedTargetName,"requestedFirmwareVersion":firmwareVersion,"wrapperDisposition":outcome,"wrapperStatusCode":outputStatusCode,"atomicResultRaw":atomicResultRaw or None,"retryRequiresInspection":True}, separators=(",", ":"))

helperReady = outcome in ("failure", "accepted", "completed") and re.fullmatch(r"[1-5][0-9][0-9]", outputStatusCode) is not None and bool(outputStatusMessage and outputResultJson) and ((outcome == "failure" and bool(outputErrorMessage)) or (outcome in ("accepted", "completed") and outputErrorMessage == ""))
